can_cu: Annual stars are placed by the stem and branch of the year viewed: Lu Cun by the stem, Qing Yang = Lu + 1, Tuo Luo = Lu − 1, Tian Ma by the year branch's trine, Tian Kui / Tian Yue and Wen Chang / Wen Qu by the stem; Tai Sui on the year branch, Sang Men = Tai Sui + 2, Bai Hu = Tai Sui + 8.
